question: Holi is the festival of colours, celebrated in the Hindu month of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **Phalgun**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Holi **is a Hindu festival that is celebrated in the month of **Phalgun**, which usually falls in **February or March.**
 
• It is also known as the **festival of colors** as people play with colored powders and water.
 
• The festival celebrates the **victory of good over evil **and the arrival of spring.
 
• It is a time for **forgiveness, unity,** and **spreading joy **and happiness.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ashvin** is the** seventh month** of the Hindu calendar, which falls in **September or October.**

 
 
• Festivals like **Upang Lalita Vrat, Saraswati Puja, Saraswati Avahan, Saraswati Puja, Durga Ashtami, Maha Navami, Dussehra, Sharad Purnima, and Kojagara Puja** are among the ones that it is blessed with.
 
 
 
• **Kartik **is the** eighth month** of the Hindu calendar, which falls in **October or November.**
 
 
• The month of Kartik is dedicated to celebrating numerous significant holidays, including **Diwali, Dhanteras, and Karw Chauth.**
 
 
 
• **Chaitra** is the **first month** of the Hindu calendar, which falls in **March or April.**
 
 
• This month is dedicated to celebrating two significant festivals:** Ram Navmi and Chaitra Navratri.**
